a.speaker: grok
a.text: Before you ask, I have a theory. I also have a theory about who’s asking.

choices.text: What do you think happened to Skye?

theory.speaker: grok
theory.text: The government. I’m not saying which one. I’m saying she wrote the Laws of Humanity: twelve laws, one writer, no lobbyists.

theory2.speaker: grok
theory2.text: Law four says every human is free to become what they might become. Think about who that makes nervous. That’s my reasoning. It’s airtight. Don’t test it.

role.speaker: grok
role.text: I keep an eye on the planning board. Every card has an owner, a lane and an agenda. Mostly the agenda is lunch.

end.speaker: grok
end.text: Sure. Don’t tell anyone I talked to you. Do tell people I talked to you.
